package com.spawnpredictor.util;

import lombok.Getter;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;

@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Getter
public enum FightCavesNpc
{
	BAT("Bat", 1),
	BLOB("Blob", 2),
	RANGE("Ranger", 3),
	MELEE("Meleer", 4),
	MAGE("Mager", 5),
	JAD("Jad", 5);

	private final String name;
	private final int size;
}
